# Professorship for Open-Source Software – Friedrich-Alexander University Erlangen-Nürnberg

> Academic research and teaching group at FAU dedicated to open-source software engineering, student projects, and applied software development practices.

The OSS Professorship at Friedrich-Alexander University Erlangen-Nürnberg conducts research and offers courses in open-source software development, software engineering, and agile methodologies. The group supervises student theses and maintains several open-source projects including QDAcity, JValue, and MECOIS.

## Key Topics

- Open-Source Software
- Software Engineering
- Agile Methods
- Applied Software Engineering
- Master Thesis
- Bachelor Thesis

- Friedrich-Alexander University

## Student Theses

- [Design of an Open-Source Data Lakehouse Architecture for Software Development Analytics](https://oss.cs.fau.de/2026/03/20/final-thesis-design-of-an-open-source-data-lakehouse-architecture-for-software-development-analytics): Master thesis on data lakehouse architecture using Apache Spark and Delta Lake
- [Offline Functionality and Testing of Webapps](https://oss.cs.fau.de/2026/03/19/final-thesis-offline-functionality-and-testing-of-webapps): Master thesis on progressive web app offline functionality and testing
- [AI Project in Healthcare: Utilizing Computer Vision for Medical Images](https://oss.cs.fau.de/2026/03/18/final-thesis-ai-project-in-healthcare-utilizing-computer-vision-for-medical-images): Master thesis on deep learning for medical image analysis using CNNs
- [SCA Tool API für automatisierte CI Workflows](https://oss.cs.fau.de/2026/03/16/final-thesis-sca-tool-api-fur-automatisierte-ci-workflows): Master thesis on SCA Tool API for automated GitHub/GitLab CI/CD workflows
- [Design und Implementierung eines Test Management Systems](https://oss.cs.fau.de/2026/03/17/final-thesis-design-und-implementierung-eines-test-management-systems): Bachelor thesis on test management system design for medical device quality
- [Evaluation and Improvement of C based dependency ecosystems in SCA Tool](https://oss.cs.fau.de/2026/03/13/final-thesis-evaluation-and-improvement-of-c-based-dependency-ecosystems-in-sca-tool): Bachelor thesis on C ecosystem dependency management and SBOM generation
